## Summary

- What changed and why.
- Link to issue: Fixes #<issue-number>

## Evidence Checklist (mandatory)

- [ ] Changelog updated
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing
- [ ] Production-like runtime validation executed
- [ ] Documentation updated (or explicit justification)

## Evidence Details (machine-readable)

EVIDENCE_CHANGELOG: OK|MISSING
EVIDENCE_TESTS: OK|MISSING
EVIDENCE_RUNTIME: OK|MISSING
EVIDENCE_DOCS: OK|MISSING
